name: EPIC 201169086
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 8.7 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201169086 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.650236 (16th-84th percentiles 8.483587-8.804233), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,748 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.83 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,186 K at its surface.
